item.title: [ 5 Maps ] Dead Center 2025
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 8
IMPORTANT ! Make sure to uncheck NEW YORK map by yuu sorata to play this map, some props can conflict with his and have missing textures or props model Find the survivors 16 years after the infection, back to the dead city of Dead Center now covered by trees, vines and foliage, destroyed buildings and abandonned downtown with tall skyscrapers. This map contain 2 NEW chapters never seen in the original Dead Center map. This map is not following the lore of the game, but contain some reference to the game trailer. (This map is called Dead Center "2025" because the zonemod version was a L4D2 Center exclusivity in 2025) The map is intentionally hard to play, medkits and weapons outside of the saferoom, very infected sided in some area and the possibility to get two tanks in chapter 4 and 5 (not always) DraGumBall: Level design | Mapping | Initial Navigation Mesh Salakirby: Navigation mesh | Navigation Mesh Polish & Bug Fixes Shigeto: Creative Contribution | Ideas & Visual References Yuu Sorata: Custom props -Special thanks- For their support: Sheo, Sirplease, Asins, Leo_Funny, Jdot, P4ws, Huezitos, AK XXII, Octajuegos, h9yota, Vylnorix Helpers: Evil, MrFunReal, Yuu Sorata, P4ws, rayolko, Zombuster, Dead 4 Mods and Hammer Editors Discord Playtesters: Lappy, Military Miku, Kederrak, Jaryd, chrome, The Crib discord, L4D2 Center If you liked my work and you want to support me: https://www.youtube.com/@DraGumBall1 Map name dc2025_1 dc2025_2 dc2025_3 dc2025_4 dc2025_5 DO NOT MODIFY, THIS MAP IS NOT ALLOWED TO BE UPLOADED EXCEPT BY THE OWNER, ANY CONTENT NOT FOLLOWING THESE RULES WILL BE REPORTED AND REMOVED.

item.title: [ 5 Maps ] Amid The Ruins
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 8
A Sequel To Dead South "After spending the night sailing down the savannah river, the survivors wake up to the Captain turning infected causing the boat to crash in Jasper County, with no immediate goal the survivors must venture forward into the unknown." Fight your way though Trailer Parks, Warehouses, Towns And a Power Plant, in this five-chapter Campaign taking place in Jasper County, SC It supports Singleplayer, Co-op, Versus, And Survival. Console Names: atr01_trailer_park atr02_outskirts atr03_town atr04_power_station atr05_plant Credits: Hsyenoh05 - Skybox for chapters 1-3 & 4, TM1566 - Color Correction for chapters 4-5, CastorJudo - Various Metal Textures The Rabbit - Frosted Glass Texture Royal Blood - Radio Song Play Testers - Warhawk, Konsta Starlight
